passive.name: King's Tribute
passive.description: When an enemy unit dies near Trundle, he heals for a percent of its maximum Health.

spells.name: Chomp
spells.description: Trundle's next Attack deals physical damage and briefly Slows by %, then Trundle gains Attack Damage for seconds and the enemy loses Attack Damage for the same duration.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation TotalDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Frozen Domain
spells.description: Trundle freezes an area for seconds. While inside he gains % Move Speed, % Attack Speed, and % increased healing.
spells.coverageNote: No champion damage packet is present for this cast.

spells.name: Pillar of Ice
spells.description: Trundle creates an icy pillar for seconds, briefly Knocking Back enemies directly over it and Slowing nearby enemies by %.
spells.coverageNote: No champion damage packet is present for this cast.

spells.name: Subjugate
spells.description: Trundle drains the lifeforce of an enemy champion, dealing max Health magic damage and stealing % Armor and Magic Resist over seconds.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation TotalPercentHPDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.
